source.lapis_dirty_scope: Architecture contract, this sanitized evidence receipt, and read-only worker outputs under ignored build/ only.

scope: Architecture-only decision for the next R1 production-client slice. No supervisor, GUI, CLI, launchd, package or runtime behavior was implemented.

inputs.name: production-client-audit
inputs.result: Mapped the one-slot state registry, effective-UID daemon admission, spawn-token boundary, GUI restart ownership and existing executable surfaces. A separately dispatched read-only client worker timed out after source inspection and was not used as final evidence.

inputs.name: birth-route-audit
inputs.result: Mapped the current LiveConnection detached-service path, the daemon birth payload and the seam needed to preserve direct service tests and preview mode.

inputs.name: package-recovery-audit
inputs.result: Mapped current app/session-service bundling, verify scope, restore LaunchAgent and the missing daemon/update/recovery gates.

current_facts: The opt-in daemon is one-shot, admits one same-effective-UID birth, selects the pinned session service, persists v2 launch state and reconstructs a live service after daemon replacement.
The normal GUI still starts services through LiveConnection and detached QProcess; no production GUI or CLI birth route exists.
No launchd supervisor registration, daemon CLI, package inclusion, update transition, reboot recovery or credential-environment admission exists.
The existing restore login helper launches the desktop in restore/serve mode and is not an independent supervisor.

decision.first_production_client: A headless lapis supervisor verb sharing the C++ supervisor and v6 protocol libraries, before any GUI or launchd wiring.
decision.process_security_boundary: Effective UID plus the private socket directory; same-UID client identity is an ownership label, not a sandbox boundary.
decision.registration_authority: launchctl and the installed plist own registration; SupervisorState owns the one-session slot; the client reconciles observations and refuses unknown-state mutations.
protocol_requirements: no automatic retry after an unknown birth result
the first route keeps the validated client-selected service endpoint
explicit operator reset and stop-or-leave disposition
implementation_order: daemon lifecycle completion and headless client
R4 package-location decision and update gate

validation.name: architecture-diff
validation.result: The architecture adds one component-ownership row, updates the open-choice gate, and appends one dated contract section without another roadmap file.

validation.name: repository-quality
validation.result: Repository contracts, diff hygiene, Ruff check/format and Python unit tests passed for this documentation-only change.

non_claims: No status control protocol, CLI, reset operation, BirthRoute strategy, LaunchAgent or package change has been implemented.
The contract does not qualify process replacement, login, reboot, update, rollback, credential environments, multi-session state, load, memory or latency.
Effective-UID admission does not protect user state from malicious software already running as that user.
Worker audits are source and receipt inspection, not process or package acceptance.
